mapper.sql: select v.visitor_id, v.community_id, v.visitor_name, v.visitor_phone, v.id_card, v.visit_room, v.owner_id, v.visit_reason, v.visit_time, v.leave_time, v.visit_status, v.create_by, v.create_time, v.update_by, v.update_time, c.community_name, o.owner_name from pms_visitor v left join pms_community c on v.community_id = c.community_id left join pms_owner o on v.owner_id = o.owner_id
mapper.insert: insert into pms_visitor (community_id, visitor_name, visitor_phone, id_card, visit_room, owner_id, visit_reason, visit_time, visit_status, create_by, create_time) values (#{communityId}, #{visitorName}, #{visitorPhone}, #{idCard}, #{visitRoom}, #{ownerId}, #{visitReason}, #{visitTime}, #{visitStatus}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: delete from pms_visitor where visitor_id in #{visitorId}
